# Wire a Rust XPCOM service through all build and platform layers

560 adds sys_tray to the workspace, gkrust and gtest, exports the constructor and registers the Linux OS integration component. Current registration and ksni dependency both require Linux and x86_64. The JS getter catches unsupported platforms and returns null. Keep the registration guard, Rust module/dependency guard and caller fallback aligned. The feature is not automatically available on every 64-bit Linux architecture. Third-party Rust dependency implementations were excluded from the study; owned integration was read in full.

Scope: Linux tray build architecture.
